services.title: Architectural Drawing
services.shortDescription: Comprehensive orthographical drawing packages including floor plans, elevations, structural sections, and construction details.
services.introduction: Precision architectural drawings form the technical backbone of every successful building project. We produce rigorous, clearly annotated drawing sheets that translate spatial intent into unambiguous technical instructions.
services.detailedExplanation: At KOLS ARCHITECTS, our Architectural Drawing service delivers coordinated orthographic projections tailored for planning review, contractor pricing, and site execution. Every sheet is structured with standardized lineweights, structural grid axes, datum levels, window and door schedules, and material callouts so architects, engineers, and builders can work from a unified source of truth.

galleryImages.alt: Orthographic Architectural Drawing Package Sheet A-100
galleryImages.caption: Coordinated orthographic elevation, section cut, and wall assembly detail sheet.

inclusions: Site plan and boundary orientation layout
Dimensioned floor plans for all building levels
Four-directional exterior architectural elevations
Longitudinal and cross-sectional building cuts
Roof plan, drainage slopes, and parapet detailing
Door, window, and finish schedules
deliverables: Scaled multi-sheet PDF drawing set (ISO A1 / A3)
Editable native CAD files (.DWG) upon request

faqs.question: What information do you need to begin architectural drawings?
faqs.answer: We can start from a land survey, hand sketch, existing PDF/image plans, or a written spatial brief outlining your required rooms, plot dimensions, and architectural style.

faqs.question: What scales and measurement systems do you support?
faqs.answer: We work fluently in both Metric (millimeters/meters) and Imperial (feet and inches) standards at standard architectural scales (1:100, 1:50, 1:20).

services.title: 2D Floor Plan Design
services.shortDescription: Intelligent top-down spatial layouts optimizing room proportions, natural daylight, circulation flow, and furniture placement.
services.introduction: A great building begins with an intelligent floor plan. Our 2D Floor Plan Design service resolves spatial relationships, privacy zoning, and circulation efficiency before costly vertical modeling or construction begins.
services.detailedExplanation: We analyze how occupants move through a property from arrival to private quarters. Each 2D floor plan is crafted to maximize usable net area, align structural spans, position fenestration for natural cross-ventilation and daylight, and verify that every room accommodates scaled furniture and ergonomic clearances.

galleryImages.alt: 2D Architectural Floor Plan with Furniture Layout and Dimensions Sheet FP-201
galleryImages.caption: General arrangement 2D layout showing room zoning, furniture blocks, and span dimensions.

inclusions: Spatial zoning (public, semi-private, private, and service cores)
Scaled room-by-room furniture and fixture arrangement
Door swings, window placements, and circulation pathways
Internal wall thicknesses and structural grid alignment
Room area schedule in square meters or square feet
deliverables: Area calculation schedule by room and level

faqs.question: Can you redesign or optimize an existing floor plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. We frequently audit existing layouts to eliminate wasted corridor space, improve natural lighting, or reconfigure rooms for modern living and commercial workflows.

faqs.question: Do your 2D floor plans include furniture layouts?
faqs.answer: Yes, every 2D floor plan includes accurately scaled furniture and sanitary fixtures so you can immediately understand true room proportions.

services.title: 3D Architectural Visualization
services.shortDescription: Photorealistic exterior and interior 3D renderings capturing authentic materials, atmospheric lighting, and architectural context.
services.introduction: Communicate unbuilt architecture with absolute visual conviction. Our 3D Architectural Visualization studio crafts cinema-grade still renders and perspectives that bring architectural concepts to life.
services.detailedExplanation: Using physically based rendering workflows, accurate solar positioning, bespoke surface shaders, and curated botanical and contextual assets, we transform 2D CAD drawings or 3D massing models into emotive, photorealistic imagery. Ideal for design validation, developer marketing, planning presentations, and client sign-off.

galleryImages.alt: Photorealistic 3D Exterior Architectural Visualization at Golden Hour
galleryImages.caption: Architectural exterior visualization showcasing travertine volumes, bronze louvers, and natural light.

inclusions: 3D architectural modeling from 2D CAD plans or sketches
Physically accurate material and texture development
Daylight, golden hour, and dusk atmospheric lighting setups
Contextual landscaping, hardscaping, and surrounding environment
High-dynamic-range post-production and color grading
deliverables: Multiple curated camera angles (eye-level, aerial, architectural vignette)

faqs.question: Can you create 3D visualizations from 2D AutoCAD drawings or hand sketches?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We build the complete 3D geometry directly from your 2D plans, elevations, or sketches and apply your specified material palette.

faqs.question: How are material revisions handled during the visualization process?
faqs.answer: Our workflow includes dedicated clay-render camera approval followed by material preview drafts, allowing you to refine finishes and lighting before final high-resolution rendering.

services.title: 3D Kitchen Design
services.shortDescription: Bespoke culinary space planning and photorealistic 3D kitchen renders detailing cabinetry, stone islands, appliances, and task lighting.
services.introduction: The kitchen is both a high-performance culinary workspace and the social anchor of the contemporary home. We design and visualize bespoke kitchens with millimeter cabinet precision.
services.detailedExplanation: Our 3D Kitchen Design service combines ergonomic work-triangle planning with tactile material visualization. We detail waterfall stone islands, concealed pantry joinery, integrated appliances, brushed metallic hardware, and layered under-cabinet and pendant lighting so homeowners and joinery fabricators can preview every detail prior to manufacture.

galleryImages.alt: Bespoke 3D Kitchen Design Render with Fluted Travertine Island and Walnut Cabinetry
galleryImages.caption: Bespoke culinary atelier with fluted travertine island, walnut joinery, and integrated bronze lighting.

inclusions: Ergonomic kitchen layout and island proportion planning
Custom cabinetry, drawer, and tall-unit elevation modeling
Countertop, backsplash, and stone veining visualization
Integrated appliance and sanitary fixture placement
Task, cove, and architectural pendant lighting simulation
deliverables: 2D kitchen layout and cabinetry elevation drawings
Material, finish, and hardware specification schedule

faqs.question: Can a contractor or cabinetmaker build from your kitchen designs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Alongside our photorealistic 3D renders, we provide dimensioned plan and elevation layouts that clearly communicate module widths, heights, and appliance clearances.

services.title: 3D Bathroom Design
services.shortDescription: Refined sanctuary bathroom concepts and 3D visualizations showcasing large-format stone, sanitaryware, custom vanities, and ambient lighting.
services.introduction: Transform utilitarian wet rooms into serene architectural sanctuaries. Our 3D Bathroom Design service visualizes tile set-outs, sanitaryware, custom vanities, and atmospheric moisture-safe lighting.
services.detailedExplanation: Bathroom spaces demand exact coordination between plumbing locations, waterproofing zones, slab falls, and tile joint alignments. We model and render bespoke bathrooms that balance spa-like tranquility with practical maintenance, enabling confident selection of stone slabs, fluted glass screens, freestanding tubs, and brushed bronze or matte black brassware.

galleryImages.alt: Luxury 3D Bathroom Visualization with Stone Vanity and Architectural Lighting
galleryImages.caption: Natural stone slab walls, bespoke vanity joinery, and warm indirect illumination.

inclusions: Wet and dry zone spatial arrangement
Custom vanity unit, mirror, and recessed niche detailing
Large-format porcelain or natural stone slab alignment
Sanitaryware, walk-in rain shower, and brassware modeling
Indirect LED cove and vanity lighting visualization
deliverables: High-resolution 3D bathroom renders from multiple viewpoints
Dimensioned wet-room floor plan and fixture layout
Tile and surface finish specification notes

faqs.question: Can you design compact en-suite bathrooms as well as large master spas?
faqs.answer: Yes. Intelligent spatial planning and lighting design are especially transformative in compact en-suites and powder rooms.

services.title: 3D Clinic Design
services.shortDescription: Specialized healthcare and medical interior visualization covering patient reception lounges, consultation suites, and clinical treatment rooms.
services.introduction: Modern healthcare environments must inspire immediate patient trust while supporting clinical hygiene and staff efficiency. Our 3D Clinic Design service elevates medical, dental, aesthetic, and wellness facilities.
services.detailedExplanation: We design and visualize patient-centered clinical interiors that replace sterile institutional tropes with calm, biophilic hospitality—without compromising clinical ergonomics, sterile zoning, or accessibility compliance. From welcoming reception desks and acoustic waiting lounges to specialized consultation and diagnostic rooms, every space is tailored to your medical brand.

galleryImages.caption: Hygienic architectural surfaces, ergonomic clinical layout, and glare-free illumination.

Consultation room, treatment bay, and diagnostic suite layouts
Clinical circulation separating patient and staff workflows
Hygienic, durable, and calming material palette selection
Glare-free architectural and clinical task lighting visualization
deliverables: Photorealistic 3D renders of reception, waiting, and clinical rooms
2D clinical space planning and patient flow diagram
Finish and lighting schedule for healthcare fit-out

faqs.question: What types of clinics do you design and visualize?
faqs.answer: We design medical outpatient centers, dental practices, dermatology and aesthetic clinics, ophthalmology suites, physiotherapy studios, and private diagnostic centers.

services.title: Living Room Design
services.shortDescription: Sophisticated living lounge spatial planning, bespoke media walls, architectural lighting, and curated furniture compositions.
services.introduction: Design the primary gathering space of your residence with editorial poise. Our Living Room Design service orchestrates proportion, acoustic warmth, focal walls, and bespoke furniture arrangements.
services.detailedExplanation: Whether configuring an intimate formal salon or a double-height open-plan living atrium, we balance architectural millwork, fireplace and media wall detailing, drapery, area rugs, and sculptural seating. Photorealistic 3D renders allow you to experience how natural daylight and evening lighting transform the room's ambiance.

faqs.question: Can you incorporate our existing furniture pieces into the new living room design?
faqs.answer: Yes. Provide dimensions and photos of your existing pieces, and we will integrate them into the 2D layout and 3D visualization alongside new architectural elements.

services.title: Home Interior Design
services.shortDescription: Holistic residential interior architecture uniting foyers, living zones, kitchens, private bedrooms, and bathrooms into one cohesive language.
services.introduction: A truly refined residence speaks a consistent architectural language from the entrance gallery to the private master suite. Our Home Interior Design service delivers unified whole-house interior concepts.
services.detailedExplanation: We establish a cohesive material, tonal, and architectural detailing vocabulary across your entire residence. By coordinating flooring transitions, door profiles, bespoke wardrobes, ceiling coffers, lighting temperature, and furniture curation simultaneously, we prevent fragmented room-by-room decisions and elevate overall property value.

galleryImages.alt: Holistic Residential Home Interior Design Visualization
galleryImages.caption: Harmonious continuity of limestone, warm timber, and architectural lighting across the home.

inclusions: Whole-home spatial flow and room-by-room furniture plans
Cohesive material, color, and texture board across all rooms
Custom wardrobe, kitchen, vanity, and architectural millwork concepts
Reflected ceiling and lighting design concepts
Photorealistic 3D renders for key residential spaces
deliverables: Complete residential interior design presentation package

faqs.question: Do you handle both new-build residences and interior renovations?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide complete interior design packages for both unbuilt residential architecture and existing homes undergoing luxury refurbishment.

services.title: Private Reception Hall Design
services.shortDescription: Prestigious architectural reception halls, Majlis salons, and private event galleries designed for distinguished hospitality.
services.introduction: Create an unforgettable sense of arrival and formal hospitality. Our Private Reception Hall Design service crafts grand salons, formal entertaining halls, and executive reception spaces.
services.detailedExplanation: Private reception halls require commanding architectural scale balanced with acoustic intimacy and ceremonial circulation. We design sculptural coffered ceilings, custom stone water-jet or inlaid flooring patterns, bronze and fluted-glass screening partitions, bespoke banquet and Majlis seating arrangements, and dramatic chandelier and cove illumination.

Service access, acoustic zoning, and guest restroom coordination

Wall elevation and bespoke joinery details

faqs.question: Can you customize seating capacities for large private gatherings?

services.title: DWG Drafting and Documentation
services.shortDescription: Precision AutoCAD .DWG drafting, PDF-to-CAD conversion, layer standardization, and construction documentation support.
services.introduction: Clean, layer-disciplined CAD files are essential for engineering coordination and construction accuracy. Our DWG Drafting and Documentation service delivers native editable CAD files built to international drafting standards.
services.detailedExplanation: Whether converting legacy paper blueprints, PDF scans, or point-cloud sketches into structured AutoCAD .DWG format, or extending your architecture firm's drafting capacity during peak deadlines, KOLS ARCHITECTS produces clean geometry, standardized AIA/ISO layering, proper external references, and paper-space title block layouts.

galleryImages.alt: AutoCAD DWG Layer Matrix and Technical Documentation Sheet DWG-410
galleryImages.caption: ISO 13567 compliant CAD layer matrix, block attributes, and structural callout documentation.

inclusions: Native 2D AutoCAD (.DWG) drafting from sketches, PDFs, or markups
Structured layer naming, block libraries, and plot-style (.CTB) setup
Structural grid, dimensioning, and annotation standardization
As-built drawing updates and redline markup incorporation
deliverables: Editable native .DWG files (compatible with AutoCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD)
Layer standard and plot style documentation

faqs.question: Can you adopt our architecture firm's custom CAD layer standards and title block?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send us your template (.DWT), title block, and CTB plot style, and our drafting team will match your studio standards seamlessly.

services.title: Residential Architecture
services.shortDescription: Bespoke architectural design for private villas, contemporary residences, duplexes, and multi-unit residential developments.
services.introduction: Architecture shaped around the rhythms of contemporary living. Our Residential Architecture service conceives private residences and housing developments that harmonize climate, site topography, and enduring form.
services.detailedExplanation: From single-family luxury villas to multi-unit residential developments, we guide residential commissions from initial site massing and solar orientation through floor plan optimization, facade composition, and full technical documentation. faqs.question: Do you design homes for international clients remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. We collaborate remotely with homeowners and developers worldwide, adapting designs to local climate conditions, plot setbacks, and construction methods.

services.title: Commercial Space Design

services.introduction: Commercial architecture must embody brand authority while maximizing spatial return on investment. We design workplaces, retail flagships, and hospitality venues that command attention.
services.detailedExplanation: Our Commercial Space Design service aligns spatial planning with operational performance and brand identity. services.title: Interior Space Planning
services.shortDescription: Strategic spatial reconfiguration, circulation analysis, and ergonomic zoning for residential, commercial, and institutional interiors.
services.introduction: Unlock the latent potential of any floor plate. Our Interior Space Planning service resolves complex spatial constraints into fluid, purposeful interior layouts.
services.detailedExplanation: Before selecting finishes or furniture, an interior must function effortlessly. We conduct rigorous spatial feasibility studies—testing multiple layout options, acoustic separation, daylight penetration, storage density, and accessibility clearances—so you can select the optimal spatial configuration with certainty.

galleryImages.alt: Interior Space Planning & Circulation Study Sheet SP-313

faqs.question: How many layout options are included in Interior Space Planning?
faqs.answer: We typically develop two to three distinct spatial layout configurations during the concept phase, then refine your preferred option into the final dimensioned master plan.

projects.title: The Aurelia Limestone Residence
projects.shortDescription: A contemporary cantilevered residence uniting honed travertine monoliths, anodized bronze louvers, and a serene reflecting court.
projects.overview: The Aurelia Limestone Residence is an architectural design and visualization study exploring horizontal monumentality and indoor-outdoor fluidity.
